description: The following letter to the editor was published in the Sept 29, 2026 edition of the Laconia Daily Sun. It suggests voters in Belmont, Sanbornton, and Tilton should vote for Don House, Don Giguere, and Bill Lawrence on November 3, 2026.

title: Vote for Bill and the two Dons
